smyx-fish-flashing-scraping-detection-analysis 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Detects abnormal fish friction behaviors ("flashing" and "scraping") via fixed aquarium cameras.
- Counts abnormal contact frequency per minute; triggers an ectoparasite risk warning if thresholds are exceeded.
- Issues real-time alerts when excessive flashing/scraping is detected, prompting early intervention.
- Integrates with smart aquarium cameras or fish disease early-warning systems.
- Considers fish species, physiological context, and avoids false alarms for bottom-dwelling or breeding behaviors.
- Implements strict user data handling and open-id verification processes for historical report access.
